entity.dndclasses.lich.say.greet: Another fool seeking forbidden knowledge. Your bones will serve me well.
entity.dndclasses.lich.say.necromancer: %s... a necromancer. You dabble in the art I mastered a thousand years ago.
entity.dndclasses.lich.say.necromancer_a: Your little undead bow to you, %s? Watch them kneel to their true master.
entity.dndclasses.lich.say.phase_raise: Rise, my servants! Rise and feast!
entity.dndclasses.lich.say.phase_despera: You cannot kill what is already dead!
entity.dndclasses.lich.say.defend: Keep your filthy hands from my phylactery!
entity.dndclasses.lich.say.flee: Fool! My soul is beyond your reach. I will return...
entity.dndclasses.lich.say.reform: Death is but a door, and I hold the key.
entity.dndclasses.lich.say.phylactery_de: No... NO! My phylactery! What have you done?!
entity.dndclasses.lich.say.death_necroma: The apprentice... surpasses... the master. Take my secrets, %s...

bounty.dndclasses.goblin_trouble.desc: Goblins have been raiding the vegetable patches again. Slay 10 goblins.
bounty.dndclasses.goblin_warlord.desc: A goblin warlord is gathering a warband in the hills. Slay him.
bounty.dndclasses.wyvern_hunt.desc: A wyvern has been carrying off sheep from the farms. Slay a wyvern.
bounty.dndclasses.storm_dragon.desc: Lightning dances on the far peaks. Slay a Lightning Chaser, if you dare.
bounty.dndclasses.frost_drake.desc: Hail falls from a clear sky over the frozen peaks. Slay a Frost Drake, if you dare.
bounty.dndclasses.spiders.desc: Great spiders are spinning webs along the forest road. Slay 8 spiders.
bounty.dndclasses.barrow_wights.desc: The dead walk out of the barrows at night. Put 15 undead back to rest.
bounty.dndclasses.brigands.desc: Brigands are robbing travellers on the road. Defeat 5 illagers.
bounty.dndclasses.dwarf_fortress.desc: Old tales tell of a dwarven fortress in the mountains. Find one and step inside.
bounty.dndclasses.dragon_lair.desc: Somewhere on a lonely summit, a dragon hoards its gold. Find a dragon's lair.

book.dndclasses.class_guidebook.title: Class Guidebook
book.dndclasses.class_guidebook.no_class: You haven't picked a class yet. Pick one in the class menu; this book will then explain yours. Until then, here is every class.
book.dndclasses.class_guidebook.intro: This book always describes your current class: its pros, its cons and its special ability.
book.dndclasses.class_guidebook.key: When your mana bar is full, press %s to use it.
book.dndclasses.class_guidebook.rebind: Change the key in Options > Controls > Key Binds > D&D Classes.
book.dndclasses.class_guidebook.obstacle: Bold ones only your class can get past. The others you can help with.
role.dndclasses.tank.description: Tanks stand in front, take the hits and keep enemies off the rest of the party.
role.dndclasses.healer.description: Healers keep the party on its feet and patch them up between fights.
role.dndclasses.damage.description: Damage dealers bring enemies down fast while the tank holds them.
role.dndclasses.support.description: Supports make everyone around them better with buffs, songs and debuffs.
role.dndclasses.utility.description: Utility classes solve the problems swords can't: gear, scouting, obstacles and odd tricks.
book.dndclasses.class_guidebook.subclass: At class level %s, choose one of these at an Attunement Table. It opens its branch of the skill tree and seals the other branch above its first node.
